shots.visual_description: Macro close-up of a woman's cheek, showing slight dullness, uneven tone and minor imperfections, dramatic side lighting emphasizing texture, shallow depth of field.
shots.narration: 每天照镜子，是不是总觉得皮肤暗沉、没有光泽？

shots.visual_description: Product hero shot of the whitening face cream, with a soft, ethereal glow, rotating slowly on a pristine white marble surface, shallow depth of field.
shots.narration: 别担心，这款美白面霜，就是你肌肤的救星！

shots.visual_description: Elegant hands applying a small amount of the cream to the other half of the face (not the dull side), close-up, natural bright light, showing the cream's smooth, non-greasy texture.
shots.narration: 轻柔涂抹，丝滑质地瞬间融入肌肤，滋润不黏腻。
shots.text_overlay: 丝滑质地 快速吸收

shots.visual_description: Close-up of the applied area on the face, skin looks hydrated and dewy, with a subtle, healthy glow, soft focus transition to slightly brighter and more even tone.
shots.narration: 坚持使用，你会发现肌肤逐渐焕发透亮光采。

shots.visual_description: Split-screen comparison: left side shows the dull, uneven skin from shot 1; right side shows the radiant, even-toned skin after using the product. Bright, even studio lighting, genuine happy expression.
shots.narration: 看看这惊人的对比，左右脸判若两人，暗沉一扫而光！

shots.visual_description: Product array with clear price tag overlay and '限时优惠' text, warm inviting lighting, subtle animation of a 'buy now' button appearing at the bottom of the screen.
shots.narration: 限时优惠，现在购买立享好礼，赶紧行动起来吧！
shots.text_overlay: 限时优惠 立即购买

market_summary.summary: 美白产品市场需求持续旺盛，消费者追求安全、高效且能改善多种肤色问题的产品。用户痛点集中在肤色暗沉、斑点难消、肤色不均等。
key_findings: 用户追求自然透亮，而非假白。
对产品成分和科学依据的信任度高。
期待产品在美白的同时兼顾保湿和温和性。
